scope: Deferred observer startup and final protocol-resource teardown before module dlclose; isolated tests, not live Hyprland frontend acceptance

primarySourceFindings.HyprlandGlobalFilter: Unsandboxed direct clients are allowed. Sandboxed clients require protocols not considered privileged by ProtocolManager whitelist
primarySourceFindings.SecurityContextMembership: Only clients registered through security-context are in the sandboxed-client vector; the provider socketpair peer is not registered there
primarySourceFindings.PluginInit: PluginSystem schedules a config reload after successful init. Observer startup now waits for the existing event loop, not constructor wall-clock time

contract.initialState: disabled without observer peer/socketpair or inventory deadline
contract.start: valid snapshot plus explicit availability request schedules one idle on the existing server loop; peer, registry and 1s deadline start there
contract.beforeClaimCancellation: Disabling before idle cancels initialization and does not consume a publication generation
contract.diagnostics: observerStartup=deferred-event-loop; failed hyprctl diagnostic registration aborts initialization before requesting publication
contract.withdraw: Retain core/globals/resources/offers for in-flight requests; withdrawn controls have a tracked owner and ignore pause/resume; no acknowledgement/activation
contract.finalize: Destroy all module-defined resources, active/retired/late controls, claim bindings, event sources and peer before module unload. No subsequent request dispatch is supported
contract.generationPolicy: Unchanged: one generation after creating a claim; no hot reload or daily activation added
contract.launcher: Requires providerLifecycleVersion exactly integer 1 and observerStartup=deferred-event-loop, in addition to previous arbitration v1 and barrier v2 guard. Rejects old module diagnostics before auxiliary launch; read-only, no load/install/enable

moduleTest.module: test-teardown-module.cpp linked to the same provider/core, with static archive symbols hidden to prevent executable interposition
operations: create provider on private data-only display
retired case adds a control from a previously offered global
destroy provider and assert zero own resources
destroy clients without dispatching queued requests
